user.title: Create a combined outlet
user.description: Select at least two physical outlets. Sensors are detected automatically from their Home Assistant devices; no helpers or YAML required.

data_description.switches: Select two or more individual physical switch entities, not a switch group.

error.at_least_two: Choose at least two different switches.
error.physical_switches_only: Choose physical switches that have a device in Home Assistant, not groups or virtual switches.
error.no_common_measurements: No common measurement sensors were detected on all selected devices. Check that the sensors are enabled and assigned to the original physical devices.

abort.already_configured: This collection of outlets is already configured.

init.title: Measurements
init.description: Untick any measurement the combined outlet should not expose. Changing this reloads the integration.
